msg: There are different colour of gnomes with a total of 8 (pink, brown, purple, red, yellow, orange, blue and green). The purple, pink, brown and red gnomes pick the red basket. The yellow, orange, blue and green gnome pick the yellow basket. some baskets cann have more mushrooms than others. If the red basket has lots of mushroom, keep choosing it. If the number of mushroom decrease, switch to the other colour (yellow).
